description:
This process begins when a potential customer inquires about a product or service.
Sales staff or customer support collects relevant information and addresses any concerns or questions.
If the customer is interested, they are guided through selecting the appropriate product or service.
Next, the sales representative provides a quote, and after approval from the customer, the process moves to order placement.
The order is then recorded in the system, and the customer receives confirmation of their order.
The process ends when the order is successfully placed and confirmed.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Sales"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/sales-order">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Inquiry" name="Customer inquiry"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Quote" name="Quote"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_QuoteResponse" name="Quote response"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Sales">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Potential customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Sales"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Inquiry" name="Inquiry" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Inquiry"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Quote" name="Quote" sourceRef="SendTask_SendQuote" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_QuoteResponse" name="Quote response" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_QuoteResponse"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="SendTask_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Sales" name="Sales and order placement" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_Inquiry" messageRef="Message_Inquiry"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect relevant customer information"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddressConcerns" name="Address concerns and questions"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterestSplit" name="Customer interested?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotInterested" name="Process ended without order (customer not interested)"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectProduct" name="Guide customer through product or service selection"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideQuote" name="Provide quote"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendQuote" name="Send quote to customer" messageRef="Message_Quote"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_QuoteResponse" name="Customer response to quote received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_QuoteResponse" messageRef="Message_QuoteResponse"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_QuoteApproval" name="Quote approved?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_QuoteNotApproved" name="Process ended without order (quote not approved)"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order in system"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed" name="Order successfully placed and confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inquiry" sourceRef="StartEvent_Inquiry" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collected" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Task_AddressConcerns"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Addressed" sourceRef="Task_AddressConcerns" targetRef="Gateway_InterestSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interested" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InterestSplit" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">Customer is interested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInterested" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InterestSplit" targetRef="EndEvent_NotInterested">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">Customer is not interested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Selected" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_ProvideQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_QuoteProvided" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="SendTask_SendQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_QuoteSent" sourceRef="SendTask_SendQuote" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_QuoteResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResponseReceived" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_QuoteResponse" targetRef="Gateway_QuoteApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_QuoteApproval" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">Customer approved the quote</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotApproved" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_QuoteApproval" targetRef="EndEvent_QuoteNotApproved">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">Customer did not approve the quote</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderPlaced" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderRecorded" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="SendTask_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmed" sourceRef="SendTask_SendConfirmation" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
